title: Transfer of any work or institutions to Panchayat

versions.Latest:
74 .   Transfer of any work or institutions to Panchayat.—   The Government may 
entrust to the Panchayat, the execution, maintenance or repair of any work or the 
management of any institution on behalf of the Government or any local authority: 
Provided that the funds necessary for the execution, maintenance or repair of the work 
or the management of the institution shall be placed at the disposal of the Panchayat by 
the Government or such local authority.
